integrity: Analytical finite-parameter proof and independently assembled finite-state diagnostic comparisons included. Finite-mesh tests do not prove continuum equations. No independent scientific audit or historical-priority certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for symmetric stationary two-state switching of two mutually exclusive absorbing endpoint gates, D,L,kappa>0, every initial position; initial gate sampled uniformly. Only simultaneous mean lifetime and exit-side splitting functions are compared to constant positive static Robin boundaries. No claim about higher dimensions, unequal switching, the full first-passage law, or general nonlocal boundaries. A relevant Robin-homogenization paper could not be examined in full; priority is provisional.
title: Finite-rate alternating boundary gates resist static Robin calibration
